search.title: треск
search.snippet: plural тре́сков) crack, crash, snap (sharp sound made when solid material breaks) Synonym: хруст (xrust) Declension of треск (inan masc-form velar-stem accent-a)

search.title: осколок
search.snippet: weaponry) (a small fragment of a bomb, shell, missile or other projectile that breaks off during an explosion), shrapnel Bilodid, I. K., editor (1970–1980), “осколок”

search.title: хан
search.snippet: hána, dodé se zazorí i konéte da počínat. Stay here in the inn until dawn breaks and the horses can rest. Derived from a Turkic language. Doublet of кан

search.title: пират
search.snippet: експлоата́тор (eksploatátor), разбо́йник (razbójnik) (by extension) pirate (one who breaks intellectual property laws by reproducing protected works without permission)

search.title: чандал
search.snippet: all the way down to the ground, freezes into an icicle; if this icicle breaks, the creature dies. Declension of чанда́л (anim masc-form hard-stem accent-a)
